## Handoff checklist

- [ ] Exactly one `type:` label, the target open release milestone and a maintainer assignee are set on GitHub.
- [ ] Local checks passed for the final patch; physical Bluetooth validation is distinguished from simulation.
- [ ] Current-head CI and review findings have been checked; pending or failed checks are reported accurately.
- [ ] Documentation impact is filled in and relevant changelog/docs/translations are updated.
- [ ] The maintainer will merge; no release, tag or hardware action is implied by this PR.
